directions: Suppose the student union of your university is organizing an online discussion on interpersonal relationships. You are to write an essay on ways to maintain a warm and friendly relationship with your classmates and on the benefits of such a relationship. You will have 30 minutes for the task.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
Maintaining a warm and friendly relationship with classmates is essential for a fulfilling college life. To begin with, effective communication is the key. By sharing thoughts and feelings openly, we can understand each other better. For example, having regular group discussions can help us know our classmates' perspectives. In addition, showing respect and understanding is crucial. Everyone has their own ideas and personalities, so respecting these differences can prevent unnecessary conflicts. 

Moreover, offering help when needed can strengthen the bond. If a classmate is struggling with a course, lending a hand can make them feel cared for. Such a relationship brings numerous benefits. It creates a positive and supportive learning environment, which can improve our academic performance. Also, it enriches our college experience and provides us with a sense of belonging. 

In conclusion, by communicating well, respecting others, and offering help, we can maintain a warm relationship with classmates, which in turn will bring us a more rewarding college life.
